issue.title: Enhancement: Log Analyzer should add the pattern of "auditd queue full reporting limit reached" from test_tc1_aaa_suite

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the enhancement

**[loganalyzer: test_tc1_aaa_suite]**

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/202405/tests/generic_config_updater/test_aaa.py#L302

these ERR messages do not always occurs. (few, not 100% reproduce)

<IPV6>.910942 MtFuji-dut ERR auditd[735]: queue to plugins is full - dropping event
&#10
<IPV6>.085986 MtFuji-dut ERR auditd[735]: queue to plugins is full - dropping event
&#10 <IPV6>.110887 MtFuji-dut ERR auditd[735]: message repeated 3 times: [ queue to plugins is full - dropping event]
<IPV6>.110950 MtFuji-dut ERR auditd[735]: auditd queue full reporting limit reached - ending dropped event notifications

**[debug]**

during the runtime of this test, tacplus is updated by testcase’s patches and triggered to Auth/A/A by sshd.

[1] sorting out the top 5 process; sshd is the major loading to be run by tacplus.
[2] by “ausearch -m all -ts recent“. we can find the event.

### Current Behavior

<IPV6>.910942 MtFuji-dut ERR auditd[735]: queue to plugins is full - dropping event
&#10
<IPV6>.085986 MtFuji-dut ERR auditd[735]: queue to plugins is full - dropping event
&#10 <IPV6>.110887 MtFuji-dut ERR auditd[735]: message repeated 3 times: [ queue to plugins is full - dropping event]
<IPV6>.110950 MtFuji-dut ERR auditd[735]: auditd queue full reporting limit reached - ending dropped event notifications

### Proposed Behavior

**[Proposal]**
we should add these traces into skip list of log-analyzer.

the reason is that
our sonic-buildimage/src/tacacs service applies the audit-plugin to show above ERR code to check if any system issue. this plug-in comes from linux debain package can not be changed (such as ERR to INFO type)

- audit-userspace/audisp/queue.c at master · linux-audit/audit-userspace
https://github.com/linux-audit/audit-userspace/blob/master/audisp/queue.c#L227

 - sonic-mgmt on this script seems to run too fast by ssh to apply patch by
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/common/gu_utils.py#L112
    since many testcase applys above, we should not change here.

**[other options]**
refine these parameter will not show any info.(not recommend)

/etc/audisp/tacplus.conf
/etc/audit/auditd.conf
queue_depth = 8192
q_depth = 8192.  (not working, I try before)

vi /etc/audit/auditd.conf
vi /etc/audit/plugins.d/tacplus.conf

/etc/audit/
-rw-r----- 1 root root  881 Feb  9  2023 auditd.conf
overflow_action = ignore
q_depth = 2000

-rw-r----- 1 root root  849 Jun 25 13:22 audit.rules
-rw-r----- 1 root root  107 Jun 25 13:22 audit.rules.prev
-rw-r----- 1 root root  127 Feb  9  2023 audit-stop.rules
drwxr-x--- 1 root root 4096 Jun 30 22:04 plugins.d

timeout = 1      # short timeout to avoid plugin hanging
retries = 0      # don't retry if slow
server=<IP>:49,secret=<REDACTED>

### Description of PR

Summary:

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
To eliminate test failure when such messages are in DUT syslog:
```
Match Messages:
2025 May 11 <IPV6>.050391 dut ERR auditd[618]: queue to plugins is full - dropping event
2025 May 11 <IPV6>.219484 dut ERR auditd[618]: queue to plugins is full - dropping event
2025 May 11 <IPV6>.244281 dut ERR auditd[618]: message repeated 3 times: [ queue to plugins is full - dropping event]
2025 May 11 <IPV6>.244402 dut ERR auditd[618]: auditd queue full reporting limit reached - ending dropped event notifications
```

#### How did you do it?
Add the regex to the `ansible/roles/test/files/tools/loganalyzer/loganalyzer_common_ignore.txt` ignore list file.

#### How did you verify/test it?
Run the `sonic-mgmt/tests/generic_config_updater/test_aaa.py::test_tc1_aaa_suite` test.
